limitations: Listing prices are asking prices; the reference columns summarise completed transactions.

The dataset has no transaction count or period column, so minimum reference-group size and temporal alignment cannot be verified directly; missing/near-zero std and zero IQR are used as proxies for an ineligible group.
Reference statistics are attached at area level and may mix property types, so a terrace house and a condominium in the same area can share one reference distribution.
The candidate's own transaction cannot be excluded because listings are not linked to individual transaction records.
M_i is a consistency score, not a valuation, under-pricing claim or investment advice.
